title: Gideon and the Letter
author: D. M. Halloran
blurb: Ada Halloran, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
